summary: Implemented all 7 phases of the topic-scoped literature coverage-delta guard. Extracted literature-discover.sh's Tier 1 matcher into a shared literature-term-match.sh; added literature-coverage-delta.sh with the D1/D2 compound trigger (LITERATURE_COVERAGE_GAP_MIN cheap pre-filter, LITERATURE_COVERAGE_DELTA_THRESHOLD keyword-matched actionable trigger), mandatory parent_doc==null filtering on the global side, and a fail-open contract; wired it into literature-lit-flag-resolve.sh's SUBINDEX_PRESENT branch (downgrading to the existing SPARSE_PROMPT_NEEDED token, no new directive) and literature-briefing.sh's repo-mode marker/banner (delta_checked=/delta_gap=/delta_candidates= appended after the pre-existing fields, plus a bounded [COVERAGE DELTA ...] banner, never setting sparse=true per D5); threaded --query through every repo-mode call site in lit-stage4a-flow.md and adhoc-navigation-directive.md so the guard is actually reachable in production; added a 6-case Section H fixture suite (fires, negative control, chunk-inflation, not-computed, fail-open, and a GAP_MIN boundary case) with all 44 suite checks passing and a trigger-inversion sanity check confirming the tests exercise real behavior; documented the mechanism in sparse-coverage.md's new Coverage-Delta Detection section, including the explicit rationale for not overloading sparse=true and the named claim-level-verifier follow-up this task does not close. Manually verified end-to-end that the autonomous path (orchestrator_mode=true) surfaces the [COVERAGE DELTA ...] banner inside lit_context without ever calling AskUserQuestion.
